Context: 11. Letters of Appreciation

2. Letters of appreciation issued in the following cases by the authorities specified therein, may, however, be kept in the APAR Dossier of the
3. Government servants concerned:-
4. (a) Issued by the Government or a Secretary or Head of Department in respect of any outstanding work done.
5. (b) Issued by special Bodies or Commissions or Committees, etc., or excerpts of their reports expressing appreciation for a Government servant by name.
